text:
Maya R: weekend request — looking for chill music and a short TV show to binge during laundry. low effort, high vibes. Any recs?
Sam T: music: Phoebe Bridgers 'Punisher' or Fleet Foxes 'Helplessness Blues' for chill. TV: 'Patriot' (less than 3 seasons). dark but funny.
Liam: if you want super short, watch the movie 'Before Sunrise' — one night, ~100 minutes, perfect during a load cycle. :coffee:
Nisha: book rec instead: 'The Night Watchman' (small, lovely). also the miniseries 'Fleabag' if you haven't seen it. so good. :laughing:
Sam T: also jazz nod: Chet Baker 'Almost Blue' — calming while folding shirts.
Maya R: ooh Fleabag is on my list, forgot about it. Liam thanks, 'Before Sunrise' is perfect. anyone got a quick playlist I can queue?
SpotifyBot: Added playlist "Laundry Vibes — Redwood" to @Maya R queue: https://open.spotify.com/playlist/37i9dQZF1DX4WYpdgoIcn6 (auto-generated).
Liam: quick homemade playlist (copy/paste):
```
1. Chet Baker - Almost Blue
2. Phoebe Bridgers - Moon Song
3. Fleet Foxes - Blue Ridge Mountains
4. Nick Drake - Pink Moon
5. Mac DeMarco - Chamber of Reflection
```
Nisha: tiny poll: movie (Before Sunrise) vs miniseries (Fleabag) — which is better for 2.5 hours of chores?
Sam T: vote: Before Sunrise (movie wins for concentrated vibes) :thumbsup:
Maya R: vote: Fleabag (laughs break monotony) :heart:
Liam: reaction: :popcorn: either way you win.
Maya R: thanks y'all — adding both to weekend plan.
